title: Restyle Video: Wan 2.2 Fun Control
description: A video given a new look: the motion and camera of your video are kept, the look comes from a style frame and the prompt (Wan 2.2 Fun Control).

labels.900:value: Describe the new look (the motion comes from the video)
labels.902:value: Length in frames (4n+1; 81 is 3.4 s at 24 fps)
labels.158:file: Source video (its motion and camera are kept)
labels.145:image: Style frame (its first frame with the new look)

hints: Make the style frame from the video's first frame with a picture model, so the people and their places match.
The length is in frames: 4n+1, such as 49, 81 or 121.
